subject: Bluehaven SIG intake & access plan
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@bluehaven.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@bluehaven.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Bluehaven security intake / SIG + SOC 2 request

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the demo last week. As part of our procurement review we've pulled together a short security appendix and SIG questionnaire that we'd like Redwood to complete. High level asks:
- SIG baseline spreadsheet (completed) or control map to SOC 2
- Artifact delivery for controls (logs, configs, policy excerpts)
- Expected timeline for collection and any gating items (PO, NDA, cross-account access)

Can you confirm who on your side will lead intake and a rough delivery timeline? I've attached the Bluehaven_RFP_Security_Appendix.pdf with the formal list.

Best,
Ellen
Director, IT Risk & Compliance
Bluehaven Systems

Attachment(s): Bluehaven_RFP_Security_Appendix.pdf (pdf)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@bluehaven.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Bluehaven security intake / SIG + SOC 2 request

Ellen — thanks for the note and the appendix. Connor here (sales lead for Bluehaven). Summary response and proposed plan below.

Quick answers:
- Primary intake lead: Connor O'Brien (sales) for coordination; Marissa Cole (Security Programs) will own artifact collection; Laura Bennett (Compliance) will handle SOC 2 control crosswalk. Stephanie (security) will own control narratives where needed.
- Timeline: we can produce a draft SIG control map and SOC 2 summary within 5 business days; full artifact bundle typically 10–14 business days once access is agreed.

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm PO/NDA gating and the preferred access method (S3 cross-account role or secure upload).
2) We'll send an "intake checklist" (attached) mapping each requested artifact to an owner and ETA.
3) If you want us to complete your SIG spreadsheet directly, send the current template and we'll populate it.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf; intake-checklist.xlsx

If that plan works, I'll loop in the infra owners and open a Jira ticket to track deliveries.

—Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: Samir Joshi <samir.j@bluehaven.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@bluehaven.com>, procure@bluehaven.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Bluehaven security intake / SIG + SOC 2 request

Connor — thanks. Confirming Samir on procurement and I'll be the technical lead for artifact ingestion. A few clarifying items:
- We prefer an S3 cross-account role for large artifacts and a secure upload link for smaller PDFs. Can you provide the required IAM trust policy and instructions?
- We need a signed NDA before sharing certain production evidence. Can you send a DocuSign link?
- Please include a HubSpot/company record link so we can reference the procurement packet.

Using your proposed timeline, we aim to have our legal sign the NDA within 2 business days. Once signed we'll coordinate access.

Thanks,
Samir
Senior Procurement Manager
Bluehaven Systems

Date: Tue, 5 May 2027 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Bluehaven security intake / SIG + SOC 2 request — internal tasking

Connor / team — putting together internal owners and an ETA based on the asks. Proposed split below:

- Marissa Cole (Security Programs): overall evidence collection, verify retained logs, coordinate S3 manifest.
- Laura Bennett (Compliance): SOC 2 control crosswalk, provide report excerpts and control tests.
- Stephanie Nguyen (Applied ML security): write short control narratives for any model-serving-specific controls (KV cache, encryption-in-transit).
- Connor O'Brien (Sales): external coordination, PO/NDA follow-up.

I created a small owner list (attached) mapping each requested item to an owner and an initial ETA (most items targeted within 10 business days assuming NDA/PO). I'll open Jira INFRA-1123 to track.

Attachment(s): control-owner-list.csv

Marissa

Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Bluehaven security intake / SIG + SOC 2 request

Samir / Ellen — quick update and next steps:

1) NDA: sending DocuSign link now (https://docusign.com/ABCDEF-Bluehaven-NDA). Please sign and notify; we will not start production artifact sharing until executed.
2) Access: we prefer S3 cross-account role for bulk artifacts. See attached s3-readme.txt for the trust policy and minimal permissions we require. If Bluehaven cannot do a role, we will provide pre-signed upload links for smaller files.
3) Deliverables & dates:
   - Draft SIG control map (populated): EOD 2027-05-11
   - SOC 2 summary + report excerpts: EOD 2027-05-12
   - Full artifact bundle (subject to NDA & access): targeted 2027-05-18 (10 business days after access confirmed)

I've opened the HubSpot company record for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/bluehaven (shared with your team). Jira ticket INFRA-1123 will hold the attachments once we upload.

If anything changes on your internal timeline, let us know — we can compress the schedule for a prioritized subset of controls if needed.

Thanks,
Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
